 FMGE October 2026 Result Expected by November 30 
 Written By : Divyani Paul Published On 2026-11-08T11:30:30+05:30   |   Updated On 8 Nov 2026 11:30 AM IST 
 New Delhi: NBEMS will declare the FMGE October 2026 results by November 30, according to the information bulletin.
 The October 2026 FMGE was conducted on October 31, 2026.
 The results for the October 2026 FMGE examination will be available in PDF format. Candidates will be able to view their total score and result status (pass/fail) in the PDF.
 Also Read: Georgia MBBS Row: NMC Issues Conflicting Responses on FMGE Eligibility for Indian Students STEPS TO CHECK FMGE OCTOBER 2026 RESULTS 
 STEP 1- Visit the official NBEMS website.
 STEP 2- Navigate to the Examinations section on the homepage.
 STEP 3- Select the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) option.
 STEP 4- Click on the FMGE October 2026 result link.
 STEP 5- The FMGE result PDF will appear on the screen.
 STEP 6- Search for the candidate's roll number in the result PDF.
 STEP 7- Check the qualifying status mentioned against the roll number.
 STEP 8- Download the FMGE result 2026 PDF and save it for future reference.
 The FMGE October 2026 result PDF contains important details related to the candidates and their examination performance. The details mentioned in the FMGE result include the examination name and session, the candidate's roll number, qualifying status, result declaration date and important instructions for qualified candidates.
 Once the results for the October 2026 FMGE are declared, successful candidates will need to complete the registration formalities required to practice medicine in India. 
 The FMGE examination serves as a gateway for foreign medical graduates to begin their clinical careers in India. Upon passing this examination, candidates can obtain official provisional or permanent registration from the National Medical Commission (NMC) or a State Medical Council.
